AppliedTactic:
induction n with
    | zero =>
      have h: S (0)=0 :=by simp[S]
      linarith
    | succ n ih =>
      match n with
      |0 =>
       have h1: S (0 + 1) =1 := by simp[S]
       linarith
      |m+1  =>
        have hm2 : 0 ≤ m + 1 := by  norm_num
        have h2 : m+1+1 =m+2 := rfl
        rw[h2]
        apply ih at hm2
        have h3: S (m+2)=2*S (m+1) +m+1+1 :=by
          simp[S]
          linarith
         linarith
